study.question: Can the stronger source preserve full-validation click AUC while reducing parameters and measured inference cost by shrinking embedding and/or dense capacity under the frozen one-pass recipe?
study.hypothesis: Observed: g2-r0004-context_only has click AUC 0.660646940486458 versus baseline-din 0.6555440824200336, but 31,793,216 of 32,060,453 parameters (99.17%) are embeddings. Its model-only batch p50/p95 are 11.726/11.864 ms; these observations do not prove redundant capacity. Mechanism hypothesis: target-aware compressed pooling may need less embedding rank and dense nonlinear width than currently allocated, allowing useful predictive information to survive lower-dimensional representations. A 2x2 width reduction tests whether storage-dominant embeddings and compute-relevant dense layers can shrink independently or jointly. This is an efficiency/capacity study of the existing source, not a new architecture or priority claim.

nearest_work.difference: Exact closest architectural control: preserve its uniform/feedback summaries, action-aware DIN scorer, context-only auxiliary embedding updates and separate task heads. Change only embedding and hidden widths, plus a private architecture copy to enforce requested embedding dimensions.

Archived v4 primary text inspected at lines 219-334 (content SHA256 5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2). Inherit target-conditioned local activation, unnormalized weighted pooling and Dice. The local source adds compression, multi-feedback routing and gradient gates; this proposal studies widths within that source. No exact original-DIN reproduction or new capacity-allocation invention is claimed.

Cached section 2.3 identifies Zenith separate ID representations and EST cross-attention/feature-specific FFNs. Neither operator is adopted. These are benchmark descriptions; the original Zenith/EST papers remain link-only and no stronger novelty comparison is made.

inherited_components: All model operations and gradient routing from g2-r0004-context_only; unmodified source_control.py is the exact archived source.

Full host data/training/scoring contract; no changes to current labels, history visibility or prediction sample identity.
study.proposed_difference: Four standalone modules form a complete 2x2: source_replay E16/Dfull; embedding_half E8/Dfull; dense_half E16/Dhalf; both_half E8/Dhalf. Dfull scorer=[64,32], towers=[128,64]; Dhalf scorer=[32,16], towers=[64,32]. The two E8 cells are candidates. Each non-source module shallow-copies FeatureMap and deep-copies its feature specs for architecture-local embedding_dim values, leaving the supplied map, vocabulary identities and information boundary intact. No projections, extra channels, loss weights, compression or gradient changes are introduced. The dense-only cell controls the effect of retaining dense capacity under a nearly equal embedding-dominated storage budget, but is not described as an exactly parameter-matched experiment.
predictions: E8 approximately halves embedding parameters to 15,896,608 if the source uniform-width, sharing and vocabulary audit passes. Host measured counts are authoritative; exact dense counts depend on the supplied field schema.

At least one E8 cell is predicted to achieve a point-estimate click delta >= -0.0010 against source_replay while reducing total parameters at least 25% and model-only batch p50 at least 10%, with p95 no more than 5% worse. These are prospective practical criteria, not observations or established equivalence.

Dense-only shrinking is expected to reduce dense MACs and parameters, but its total-parameter savings may be below 1% because embeddings dominate. End-to-end throughput may improve less than model latency due to loading.

Estimate both single-factor effects at both levels and the AUC interaction. Inspect all four task AUC/Logloss values and the existing history-length slices with counts/positive/negative counts; empty-history slices may have broad uncertainty.

Use three host-authorized paired seeds for a promising cell and closest controls when possible; report seed deltas and a paired user-cluster bootstrap only if the host supplies authorized grouping/evaluation. A robust retention claim requires uncertainty consistent with the -0.0010 margin, not a nonsignificant difference.
falsifiers: Repeated, matched-recipe E8 contrasts consistently below -0.0010 click delta falsify retention at width 8 in this tested recipe; intervals crossing the margin are inconclusive, not proof of equivalence.

No E8 cell meeting both the declared quality and measured cost criteria falsifies the proposed combined efficiency benefit for this grid; parameter reduction without latency benefit supports storage savings only.
If apparent gains disappear across paired seeds, arise only from different training exposure, or require changed optimizer/visibility/scoring contracts, the proposed attribution is unsupported.

Any failure of masking, task-output/gradient checks, source replay, requested-width audit or feature-map immutability is an implementation/execution issue; preserve it and do not report it as scientific evidence against capacity reduction.
alternative_explanations: Width changes alter random-number consumption and initial functions, even at the same seed; they are paired training recipes, not identical initial weights.
Embedding width also changes downstream input widths and representation/interaction rank. This study estimates their joint effect and cannot isolate table storage from rank.
Joint scorer/tower shrinking does not identify scorer versus tower redundancy separately.
Fixed one-pass optimization can favor one width through conditioning or regularization. Results apply to the frozen recipe, not converged optima.
Latency depends on bandwidth, kernel utilization, loading and device conditions; parameter savings alone do not establish measured speedup.

The stronger source has auxiliary AUCs 0.66415/0.70960/0.66880, substantially below baseline-din 0.84907/0.86490/0.87018. Preserving source click AUC does not establish four-task quality parity or production utility.

Only baseline-din and g2-r0004-context_only are authorized local observations. Other ancestor branches, including failed or abandoned trajectories, are unavailable here; no reconstruction or causal claim about those branches is made.
Frozen official_offline feedback may be immature at online prediction time; benchmark retention cannot establish point-in-time deployment validity.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Retrieved card highlights separate ID capacity and a uniform-width control. Local measured parameter dominance supports first testing simple uniform/dense reductions; no observed per-field redundancy or authorized frequency diagnostics justify an ID-specific allocation yet. Original paper detail remains unverified.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None adopted: no expanded ID tables, ID tokens or Zenith blocks.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Our cells retain the source representation units and pooling and vary two widths; Zenith card describes separate ID and attribute paths. This is a limited descriptive distinction, not an originality claim.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If E8 consistently loses quality, reconsider selective capacity retention only with field-frequency diagnostics and matched-total-parameter controls; the card alone does not predict local success.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Cross-attention and feature-specific FFNs would introduce new operators and confound this initial capacity attribution. The local evidence identifies parameter/cost uncertainty, not a demonstrated need for repeated retrieval. Rejection applies to this study only; no negative transfer was measured.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None adopted: no iterative cross-attention or feature-specific FFNs.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: This source uses fixed compressed DIN readout and four towers; the EST card describes cross-attention plus feature-specific FFNs. Original EST full-paper audit is unavailable, so no broader claim is made.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If simple reductions cannot retain quality, a later retrieval/interaction replacement with matched capacity and cost could test whether a different allocation is useful.
